metadata.source: (int) cast of a float is a no-op, leaving a float in an int variable; float and int mapping keys differ; member_array separates 1.0 from 1 although == does not
metadata.fluffos_fact: (int) on a float is a no-op, so an int variable can hold 2.9; float and int mapping keys differ; member_array(1.0, ({ 1 })) is -1 although 1 == 1.0. A local declared without initialiser in a loop body keeps its value across iterations. sprintf %05d pads a negative number with zeros before the sign: "000-3".
